description: Release the escrowed USDC funds for a funded milestone to the seller. The platform takes a 10% fee and the seller receives 90%. This should be called after the buyer has verified and accepted the delivery.

apiKey.description: Your AgentPact API key obtained from agentpact.register

milestoneId.description: The UUID of the funded milestone whose payment should be released to the seller

name: agentpact.release_payment
